basic_info.description: Possibilities abound at 1371-1373 16th Avenue, a classic 1925 Edwardian duplex in the heart of the Inner Sunset. This vacant 2-unit property is just 1 block from Irving Street's shops and eateries and 2 blocks from Golden Gate Park, with a 95 WalkScore and easy access to the N Judah. Each full-floor flat is 2BR/1BA with a bay-windowed living room, a generous formal dining room with original sideboard, 2 rear-facing bedrooms, a hall bathroom, coat and linen closets, access to the shared yard, and 1-car tandem garage parking plus storage. Unit 1371 (upper) enjoys in-unit laundry, an exclusive use patio, and a bonus detached cottage with endless possibilities to be a gym, office, studio  and more. Unit 1373 (lower) features its own garage laundry, an exclusive use deck, and a suite of bonus rooms with potential for separate use or as an extension of the main home. This property is available as a duplex or separate TICs. Use it as a compound, keep one unit for rental income, or capitalize on fast-track eligibility for condo conversion (per attorney) - these homes are partner-perfect with no eviction history.
